name: memalyze
description: Self-hosted agent memory with redaction before write and an append-only audit log.
long_description:
memalyze is one static binary that speaks MCP over stdio. Memories live in a local SQLite file. Phone numbers, e-mail addresses, national IDs, bank cards and API keys are replaced with stable markers before dedup, full-text indexing and embedding, so the plaintext never reaches the database. Every add, search and delete is appended to an audit table (queries stored as SHA-256 + length) and can be exported as CSV.

Embeddings run locally through Ollama (qwen3-embedding:0.6b by default). If Ollama is not running, search degrades to keyword mode and reports degraded=true instead of hanging.

Not included: per-user authentication, reversible redaction, an audit UI. Those limits are written down in SECURITY.md.

db_path.title: Database path
db_path.description: SQLite file for memories and the audit log. Created on first write; keep it on a local disk.

ollama_url.title: Ollama URL
ollama_url.description: Local Ollama endpoint. If it is unreachable, search still works in keyword mode and says so.
